entries.what: Rochelle walks the Ulloa Salt Marsh boardwalk for her back, then drives the van to Tamsen Valley and eats her packed lunch in Lot C.
entries.outcome: Back loosened up enough to sit through lecture.

entries.what: Anatomy with Dr. Okoye at 9, seated next to Linh, taking handwritten index card notes.
entries.outcome: Filled a new color-banded card set for the week.

entries.what: Aaliyah leaves for her first evening seasonal Ridgeline shift, 6 p.m. to 2:30 a.m. Rochelle packs her a dinner and sorts the fridge calendar around her four nights.
entries.outcome: Aaliyah's new schedule goes on the paper calendar in her own color pen.

entries.what: Studies at the kitchen table after 9 p.m. once the house is quiet.
entries.outcome: Got through the heart chapter outline.

entries.what: Intro Chemistry at 11. Before class she texts for help memorizing the heart chambers and asks for just three things, no essay.
entries.outcome: Got a short list and copied it onto an index card.

entries.what: Drives mother-in-law Loretta to her 3:30 checkup and pharmacy run, which clashes with Pedro's study group.
entries.outcome: Skipped study group again this week.

entries.what: Cooks dinner for Andre and DeShawn. Andre mentions the yard was busy and hospital news comes up on the radio about St. Anselm's new charting system going live.
entries.outcome: Quiet dinner, then homework with DeShawn nearby.

entries.what: Anatomy at 9 and the Wednesday lab, standing a lot to spare her back.
entries.outcome: Lab went fine; she was loud with questions.

entries.what: Stops by Dr. Okoye's office hours, 1 to 2 in S-214, to ask about the upcoming quiz block and mentions the practical for the first time.
entries.outcome: Learned the practical is Oct 17.

entries.what: Laundry night with the old hospital drama on.
entries.outcome: Folded everything before bed.

entries.what: Keisha calls on her 10 a.m. break. Rochelle practices online anatomy quiz questions on her phone and gets 5 of 10, although Okoye quizzed her out loud earlier and she got 9 of 10 on the same material.
entries.outcome: Frustrated that she knows it aloud but the timer wrecks her.

entries.what: Chemistry at 11, then lunch from the blue cooler bag in Lot C.
entries.outcome: Finished the moles worksheet.

entries.what: Dinner with Andre and DeShawn before Aaliyah leaves for her shift.
entries.outcome: Sent Aaliyah off with leftovers.

entries.what: Anatomy at 9, where the first quiz block comes back and her grade sits at 72%. She decides Dr. Okoye is cold and enjoys watching people sweat.
entries.outcome: Sat in the car in Lot C stewing before driving home.

entries.what: Luisa sends warehouse gossip voice notes at 11:30 and Rochelle listens in the car.
entries.outcome: Laughed for the first time that day.

entries.what: Does a few pages of review at the kitchen table, then folds laundry.
entries.outcome: Planned extra card review for the weekend.

entries.what: Rochelle takes the family to the Calle Ortega Street Fair, with Andre and DeShawn eating tacos and her buying a cheap fair snack.
entries.outcome: Spent under her small fun budget.

entries.what: Stops in at Ruiz Family Market for meat for Sunday batch cooking, since the fair crowds filled Calle Ortega.
entries.outcome: Bought chicken for baked chicken.

entries.what: Reviews index cards at night while Aaliyah works her shift.
entries.outcome: Went through the heart and circulation cards.

entries.what: Skips the 11 a.m. Baptist service to cook, doing Sunday batch cooking of baked chicken for the week.
entries.outcome: Containers lined up for the week.

entries.what: Andre watches football and falls asleep by the second half while Rochelle reviews cards nearby.
entries.outcome: Quiet afternoon of study.

entries.what: Updates the fridge calendar for the week including Aaliyah's shifts and Loretta Tuesday.
entries.outcome: Week mapped out in color pens.
